text: `work_package.objective` and `work_package.body` round-trip authored WP prose verbatim: a work package carrying sections beyond the template survives canon -> view -> canon byte-identical, and `intent search` finds a phrase that appears only in a WP body (D28; the gap that made AC-06.4's "WP text" unindexable, since the model had no WP prose to index). **Canon half VERIFIED at `9a38875` (vc); the other two halves are not yet buildable.** `work_package` carries `objective` and `body` in the model, and 188 bytes of multi-paragraph markdown -- a non-template `##` section, a table, `*emphasis*`, a code span -- survive `sync` byte-identical with zero residue, which is D22's accepted cost holding in practice. **Search arm also VERIFIED at `1ca760b`**: a word appearing only in `wps[0].body` returns `ST0001/01`, which is this AC's discriminator -- a hit on the WP rather than on its parent thread. The migration risk D28 was raised against is already closed by the canon half -- prose has somewhere to land, so WP-10 can no longer port a work package by dropping it. **VIEW ARM NOW LANDED (vc, 2026-08-15): `wp_prose_roundtrip.rs` renders the `WP/<NN>/info.md` view, carries authored sections verbatim, leaves the canon byte-identical, and renders the same bytes twice.** That was the whole remainder as this row last read it, so two of three arms are now green and guarded. **WHAT IS LEFT IS NOT AN UNBUILT ARM BUT AN UNGUARDED ONE, and it is the subtler failure: the search arm was verified ONCE, by hand, at `1ca760b`, and NOTHING TESTS IT.** `wp_prose_roundtrip.rs` says so in its own header -- "search half were verified independently" -- and `search_surface.rs` covers a WP **title**, which is not what this row requires: the discriminator is a phrase appearing only in a WP **body**, because a hit on the title could come from the parent thread's index entry. A property demonstrated once and guarded by nothing is a property that decays silently, which is the exact class this thread keeps catching. **CLOSED 2026-08-15, verified by vc: `a_phrase_only_in_a_work_package_body_is_found_and_names_the_work_package`.** All three arms now guarded. **cc mutation-proved the discriminator rather than asserting it, and the mutation is the evidence this row wanted: stop indexing WP bodies in ingest and `a_word_in_a_work_package_title_is_found` STAYS GREEN while only the new test fails.** The title test cannot discriminate a WP hit from its parent thread's, which is what this row claimed and what is now demonstrated
